title: Burning Blossom
body:
"Burning blooms are fiery flowers that radiate warmth and intensity."

Description

This rare flower glows neon orange. This flower spawns in the Magma tree "grove" but there have been instances of them growing lower and closer to the entrance to the magma caves. It's used to craft the Petalfall and Blizzard's Bane. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 350$ per Burning Blossom. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~43.47% per flower.
